pairs.subject: agent-memory
pairs.evidence: src/hooks/useModuleCLI.ts:260 Skill packs chosen from mined telemetry patterns are injected into the agent's prompt, but a failed or non-ok read is swallowed and treated exactly like an empty result, so the agent runs without its learned packs and nobody is told.

techniques.evidence: src/hooks/useModuleCLI.ts:260 resolveAndApplySkills drops the read on error (and on !res.ok) with no status signal, so failed recall looks the same as empty recall. The sibling useModuleRunEvidence does separate them (RunEvidenceState loading/ready/failed).

src/hooks/useModuleCLI.ts:121 The run-outcome episode copies the full enriched prompt, with no distilled body and no pointer to the source. pattern-extractor.ts then clusters those raw prompts, so the episode store is a second prompt-transcript store. The capture boundary (endRun) is correctly event-based.
